summary: Pull requests now skip linux-gate, mail-redelivery-canaries, isolation-vm and genie-freshness when a trusted signed note already covers the tree (one run in five still runs each to compare); the merge queue keeps running all of them

replay.detail: No graph, claim or storage change.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rule change. The four checks are enforced in the skip policy for pull_request only.

compatibility.detail: Required check names and results are unchanged: a skipped job still ends in success. Merge-group runs are unchanged.

recovery.detail: Set enforce back to false for the check in .st/evidence-skip-policy.json (the policy is read from the base, so it takes effect for runs after the revert merges).
